title: Hansi Flick's 100 Barça Wins in 131 Games

voice.note: say = what Kokoro reads (names respelt so they come out right); text = the caption

sources: FC Barcelona, 'Hansi Flick: Record-breaking 100 wins', 31 October 2026: 100th win v Alavés; 100 wins in 131 games, second fastest in club history; only Luis Enrique faster (126 games); 76.33% win rate, highest of any Barça manager. https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4601449/hansi-flick-record-breaking-100-wins

FC Barcelona, 'FC Barcelona 6-1 Alavés: That's more like it!', 31 October 2026: after defeats to PSG and Real Madrid; goals Raphinha 8' (15 passes, 9 players; Pedri outside-of-the-boot pass, Fermín squared from the left), Fermín 23', Raphinha 41', Lamine Yamal 45+', Lamine Yamal 65' (VAR confirmed), Gordon 81' (chip), Mariano 84' for Alavés; four before the break, two after; Raphinha 15 league goals in 11 games, equalling César Rodríguez and Leo Messi; Fermín a goal and two assists; 53,523 at Spotify Camp Nou. https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4602177/fc-barcelona-6-1-alaves-thats-more-like-it
